mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class (name, description, teacher_id, invite_code, semester, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{teacherId}, #{inviteCode}, #{semester}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE class SET name=#{name}, description=#{description}, semester=#{semester}, status=#{status}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.username AS teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_member WHERE class_id=c.id) AS member_count FROM class c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id=u.id WHERE c.id=#{id}
SELECT c.*, u.username AS teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_member WHERE class_id=c.id) AS member_count FROM class c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id=u.id WHERE c.invite_code=#{inviteCode}

SELECT c.*, u.username AS teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_member WHERE class_id=c.id) AS member_count FROM class c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id=u.id WHERE c.teacher_id=#{teacherId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.*, u.username AS teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_member WHERE class_id=c.id) AS member_count FROM class c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id=u.id INNER JOIN class_member cm ON cm.class_id=c.id WHERE cm.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_member (class_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{classId}, #{userId}, #{role})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM class_member WHERE class_id=#{classId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM class_member WHERE class_id=#{classId} AND user_id=#{userId}
